location_description: Ventnor City is a city in Atlantic County, New Jersey, United States. As of the 2020 United States census, the city's population was 9,210, a decrease of 1,440 in the preceding decade. As of the 2010 U.S. census, the city's population was 10,650, reflecting a decrease of 2,260 (−17.5%) from the 12,910 counted in the 2000 census, which had in turn increased by 1,905 (+17.3%) from the 11,005 counted in the 1990 census.Ventnor City was incorporated as a city by an act of the New Jersey Legislature on March 17, 1903, from portions of Egg Harbor Township.
